```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(crisprBase)
library(crisprBowtie)
library(crisprDesign)
library(crisprScore)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0)
```

## Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
# Load the consistently unrepresented genes from SuppTable1C. Genes with NA
# num_pam_site are excluded (expect only the documented 7-gene strand-specific
# PAM-counting gap now, not a T2T-mapping gap -- see PLAN_B notes).
get_unrepresented_genes <- function(filepath) {
  read_excel(filepath) %>%
    filter(!is.na(num_pam_site)) %>%
    pull(gene_id)
}

# Collect all disposed guide IDs across every disposal category column in the TSV.
build_disposed_set <- function(disposed_df) {
  disposed_df %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    as.character() %>%
    unique()
}

# Count unique surviving spacer sequences per gene in one library.
# Subtracts all disposed guide IDs from the original library, then counts
# distinct spacer sequences per gene to avoid overcounting duplicate guide IDs.
count_surviving_from_library <- function(lib_df, disposed_df, unrepresented_genes) {
  disposed <- build_disposed_set(disposed_df)

  surviving_counts <- lib_df %>%
    filter(gene %in% unrepresented_genes, !sgrna %in% disposed) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(spacer), .groups = "drop")

  tibble(gene = unrepresented_genes) %>%
    left_join(surviving_counts, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L))
}

# Returns a data frame (genes x libraries) of surviving guide counts across
# all libraries.
# lib_disposed_pairs: named list where each element is list(lib=..., disposed=...)
count_surviving_guides_all_libraries <- function(lib_disposed_pairs, unrepresented_genes) {
  counts_list <- purrr::map(names(lib_disposed_pairs), function(lib_name) {
    pair <- lib_disposed_pairs[[lib_name]]
    count_surviving_from_library(pair$lib, pair$disposed, unrepresented_genes) %>%
      rename_with(~ lib_name, .cols = "n")
  })

  purrr::reduce(counts_list, left_join, by = "gene")
}

# Return rows from lib_df for target_genes that were NOT disposed,
# deduplicated by (spacer, gene) to remove same-sequence duplicates within
# the same library.
get_surviving_guide_sequences <- function(lib_df, disposed_df, target_genes) {
  disposed <- build_disposed_set(disposed_df)

  lib_df %>%
    filter(gene %in% target_genes, !sgrna %in% disposed) %>%
    distinct(spacer, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Build a mini library of surviving sgRNAs across all libraries for target_genes.
# Each guide is tagged with its source library.
# Returns a data frame with columns: sgrna, spacer, gene, source_library
build_rescue_library <- function(lib_disposed_pairs, target_genes) {
  map_dfr(names(lib_disposed_pairs), function(lib_name) {
    pair <- lib_disposed_pairs[[lib_name]]
    get_surviving_guide_sequences(pair$lib, pair$disposed, target_genes) %>%
      mutate(source_library = lib_name)
  }) %>%
    select(sgrna, spacer, gene, source_library)
}

# Annotate each row of rescue_library with whether its spacer appears in more
# than one library for the same gene.
# Adds column duplicate_spacer_sequence: "Yes (Lib1, Lib2)" or "No".
annotate_duplicate_spacers <- function(rescue_library) {
  spacer_libs <- rescue_library %>%
    group_by(gene, spacer) %>%
    summarise(
      n_libs   = n_distinct(source_library),
      dup_libs = paste(sort(unique(source_library)), collapse = ", "),
      .groups  = "drop"
    )

  rescue_library %>%
    left_join(spacer_libs, by = c("gene", "spacer")) %>%
    mutate(
      duplicate_spacer_sequence = if_else(
        n_libs > 1,
        paste0("Yes (", dup_libs, ")"),
        "No"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-n_libs, -dup_libs)
}

# Remove cross-library duplicate spacers (keep first occurrence per gene),
# then retain only genes with >= min_guides unique spacers.
deduplicate_rescue_library <- function(rescue_library, min_guides = 3) {
  rescue_library %>%
    distinct(spacer, gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    filter(n() >= min_guides) %>%
    ungroup()
}

```

## Data import

```{r import-disposed-sgrnas}
brunello_disposed <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13",
       "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
tkov3_disposed <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13",
       "tkov3_guide_sequence_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

avana_disposed <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13",
       "avana_library_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
jacquere_disposed <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "guiderefine_output", "Jul2026_T2T-CHM13",
       "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r import-restricted-libraries}
lib_cols <- c("sgrna", "spacer", "gene")

# Restricted+control subset libraries (Step 0), not the original raw ones --
# the whole point of the from-scratch rebuild is that every downstream step
# reads only this universe.
avana_lib <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "library_data", "restricted_library", "avana_library.tsv"),
  col_names = lib_cols, show_col_types = FALSE
)
brunello_lib <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "library_data", "restricted_library",
       "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents.tsv"),
  col_names = lib_cols, show_col_types = FALSE
)
tkov3_lib <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "library_data", "restricted_library", "tkov3_guide_sequence.tsv"),
  col_names = lib_cols, show_col_types = FALSE
)
jacquere_lib <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "library_data", "restricted_library",
       "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4.tsv"),
  col_names = lib_cols, show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r import-unrepresented-genes}
# Consistently unrepresented genes across five CRISPR-KO libraries, from the
# fresh SuppTable1C (dynamically named -- reads whichever gene count it was
# actually built with, not a hardcoded old count).
supp_table_1c_path <- list.files(here("library_survey_supplementary_materials"), pattern = "^supp_table_1c_.*_genes\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)[1]
unrepresented_genes <- get_unrepresented_genes(supp_table_1c_path)
message("Unrepresented genes loaded: ", length(unrepresented_genes))

lib_disposed_pairs <- list(
  Avana    = list(lib = avana_lib,    disposed = avana_disposed),
  Brunello = list(lib = brunello_lib, disposed = brunello_disposed),
  TKOv3    = list(lib = tkov3_lib,    disposed = tkov3_disposed),
  Jacquere = list(lib = jacquere_lib, disposed = jacquere_disposed)
)
```

## Data preparation — surviving guides per gene across libraries

```{r surviving-guides}
surviving_guides <- count_surviving_guides_all_libraries(lib_disposed_pairs, unrepresented_genes)

surviving_guides <- surviving_guides %>%
  mutate(sum_guides = Avana + Brunello + TKOv3 + Jacquere) %>%
  filter(sum_guides > 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(sum_guides))

cat("Shape:", nrow(surviving_guides), "x", ncol(surviving_guides),
    " — rows should be <= the unrepresented-gene count loaded above (4 libraries + gene + sum)\n")

head(surviving_guides, 20)
```

## Data preparation — rescue library

```{r rescue-library}
target_genes   <- surviving_guides$gene

# Full rescue library: all per-library survivors with duplicate annotation.
# duplicate_spacer_sequence column flags spacers shared across libraries for the same gene.
rescue_library <- build_rescue_library(lib_disposed_pairs, target_genes) %>%
  arrange(gene) %>%
  annotate_duplicate_spacers()

cat("Total guide entries :", nrow(rescue_library), "\n")
cat("Unique sequences    :", n_distinct(rescue_library$spacer), "\n")
cat("Target genes covered:", n_distinct(rescue_library$gene), "\n")

head(rescue_library, 20)

# Deduplicated TSV: cross-library duplicate spacers removed, genes with < 3
# unique spacers dropped. This is the final rescue library for downstream use.
rescue_library_deduped <- deduplicate_rescue_library(rescue_library)

cat("\nAfter deduplication:\n")
cat("Unique sequences    :", n_distinct(rescue_library_deduped$spacer), "\n")
cat("Genes with >=3 guides:", n_distinct(rescue_library_deduped$gene), "\n")

rescue_library_df <- rescue_library_deduped %>%
  mutate(sgrna = paste0(sgrna, "_", source_library)) %>%
  select(sgrna, spacer, gene)

```

## On-target efficiency scoring (Rule Set 3)

```{r on-target-ruleset3}
data(SpCas9, package = "crisprBase")
bsgenome     <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0
bowtie_index <- "d:/GitHub/GuideRefine/bowtie_index/T2T-CHM13_bsgenome/T2T-CHM13_BSgenome"

# Assign each unique spacer to one scoring method based on first occurrence in the
# deduplicated library (Avana/Brunello/TKOv3 precede Jacquere in lib_disposed_pairs order)
spacer_method <- rescue_library_deduped %>%
  distinct(spacer, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(spacer, method = if_else(source_library == "Jacquere", "Chen2013", "Hsu2013"))

non_jaq_spacers <- spacer_method %>% filter(method == "Hsu2013")    %>% pull(spacer)
jaq_spacers     <- spacer_method %>% filter(method == "Chen2013") %>% pull(spacer)

# Helper: align spacers to T2T-CHM13 and retain uniquely mapping hits
align_unique <- function(spacers) {
  runCrisprBowtie(
    spacers,
    mode                = "spacer",
    bsgenome            = bsgenome,
    crisprNuclease      = SpCas9,
    n_mismatches        = 0,
    force_spacer_length = TRUE,
    canonical           = TRUE,
    bowtie_index        = bowtie_index
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(chr)) %>%
    group_by(spacer) %>%
    filter(n() == 1) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Helper: build GuideSet from alignment hits
make_guide_set <- function(aln) {
  GuideSet(
    ids            = aln$spacer,
    protospacers   = aln$protospacer,
    pams           = aln$pam,
    pam_site       = aln$pam_site,
    seqnames       = aln$chr,
    strand         = aln$strand,
    CrisprNuclease = SpCas9,
    bsgenome       = bsgenome
  )
}

# --- Score Brunello / Avana / TKOv3 with Hsu 2013 ---
aln_non_jaq <- align_unique(non_jaq_spacers)
gs_non_jaq  <- make_guide_set(aln_non_jaq) %>% addOnTargetScores(methods = "ruleset3", tracrRNA = "Hsu2013")

hsu2013_df <- as.data.frame(mcols(gs_non_jaq)) %>%
  mutate(spacer = names(gs_non_jaq)) %>%
  select(spacer, ruleset3_score = score_ruleset3)

cat("Uniquely aligned — non-Jacquere (Hsu2013)  :", nrow(aln_non_jaq), "/", length(non_jaq_spacers), "\n")

# --- Score Jacquere with Rule Set 3 ---
aln_jaq <- align_unique(jaq_spacers)
gs_jaq  <- make_guide_set(aln_jaq) %>% addOnTargetScores(methods = "ruleset3", tracrRNA = "Chen2013")

ruleset3_df <- as.data.frame(mcols(gs_jaq)) %>%
  mutate(spacer = names(gs_jaq)) %>%
  select(spacer, ruleset3_score = score_ruleset3)

cat("Uniquely aligned — Jacquere (Ruleset3)     :", nrow(aln_jaq), "/", length(jaq_spacers), "\n")

# --- Combine scores and join to rescue library ---
scores_df <- bind_rows(hsu2013_df, ruleset3_df)

cat("RS3 score range (Hsu2013 tracrRNA) :", round(range(hsu2013_df$ruleset3_score,  na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("RS3 score range (Chen2013 tracrRNA):", round(range(ruleset3_df$ruleset3_score, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")

rescue_library_score_annotated <- rescue_library_df %>%
  left_join(scores_df, by = "spacer") %>%
  mutate(on_target_efficiency = if_else(ruleset3_score > 0, "High (>0)", "Low (≤0)"))

cat("Guides without score (unmapped/multi-mapping):",
    sum(is.na(rescue_library_score_annotated$ruleset3_score)), "\n")

# Genes with at least 3 high-efficiency guides (RS3 score > 0)
survived_genes_targeted <- rescue_library_score_annotated %>%
  filter(ruleset3_score > 0) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\nGenes with >= 3 high-efficiency guides (RS3 score > 0):",
    n_distinct(survived_genes_targeted$gene), "\n")

write.xlsx(survived_genes_targeted,
           here("library_survey_supplementary_materials", "supp_table_1b_aggregated_on_target_guides_represented_genes.xlsx"),
           rowNames = FALSE)

```
